parsed.draft_response:
apologetic

I’m sorry this is happening again and that it’s impacting your team. We’ll get this escalated to engineering, but we’ll need a couple details to identify which failure you’re seeing “as last time.”

Please reply with the minimum info below:
1) What exact function is broken (e.g., login, syncing, importing, API actions, payments)?
2) Any error message/code you see (or a screenshot) and where it appears.
3) When it started and whether it’s continuous or intermittent.
4) Which environment/platform is affected (web, iOS/Android; production vs staging; your account/org name or workspace).

If you have it, also share the approximate timestamp of the last successful use and any relevant request/log IDs from the app.

Once we have this, engineering can investigate the recurring behavior and prioritize a fix. In the meantime, if there’s a workaround you’re currently using, tell us what it is so we can help assess alternatives.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to engineering for investigation
safety_notes: Issue description is vague and recurring; avoid claiming specific root cause or resolution.
Ask for minimal, actionable troubleshooting details (errors, timestamps, affected feature/platform).
Do not promise a refund, fix timeline, or SLA.
